title: 第25章 继续忽悠第26章 别乱动
content_zh:
二狗子每次来见李半仙，都少不得要买一块肥膘肉孝敬师父。
虽然每次买肉的时候，有点犹豫，有点心疼银子，自己都没舍得吃肥膘肉。
但师父是世外高人，神仙一般的人物，对自己恩重如山，值得这一块猪肉。
“师父，我能捏碎石头了！”
师徒见面的第一时间，二狗子自然要跟师父分享成功的喜悦。
他能取得如今的成绩，都是师父教导有方。
“怎么可能？”
李半仙本能地就感觉不可能，人的手指怎么可能捏碎石头。
这几门破烂功法，他又不没练过，除了胃口大开，多糟践几碗饭，什么用都没有。
至于每次表演的捏石成粉，自己心里还是有点数的。
但很快他也察觉到自己失语，接着说道。
“怎么可能这么快？”
李半仙说着，从地上捡起一块石头摆到桌上，让二狗子捏。
“你把这块石头捏碎给为师看看。”
二狗子拿起桌上的石头，暗中运转真气。
“砰”
碎石四溅，一块鸡蛋大小的青石，被他捏得四分五裂，碎成好几块。
李半仙哆哆嗦嗦地扯着稀疏的胡须，仍然难以掩饰他心中的激动。
他捡石头的时候就确认过，是一块真正的石头，不是什么道具。
难道刚才走眼，不小心捡了块道具石头？

不太死心，捡起一小块被二狗子捏碎的石头，手缩回袖中使劲捏。
捏！
使劲捏！
咬牙切齿捏！
脸都憋红了，小石头纹丝不动。
李半仙又一次陷入了深深的自我怀疑与纠结之中。
不过，这么多年的职业素养，使他处变不惊，面不改色。
“不错！不错！”
“能把石头捏碎，算是小有成就。”
“不过，全凭一股暴力，仍然欠缺一些火候。”
李半仙感觉越来越不好忽悠了，心里很有压力。
“师父教训得对，弟子这点微末本事在师父面前，如同……如同那什么萤火与……与日月争辉。”
二狗子虽然修为精进比较快，但启蒙读物是一本没头没尾的功法。
此刻想学文化人说两句比较体面的话谦虚一下，却说得磕磕绊绊。
“已经很不错了，但仍需努力。”
李半仙终究是老江湖，很快就从精神内耗中挣扎出来，此刻风轻云淡，一派高人风范。
“你的基础剑式练得怎样了？”
“我已经可以使用60斤重剑练习基础剑式。”
content_en:
Every time Er Gouzi comes to see Li Banxian, he must buy a piece of fat meat to honor his master.
Although every time I buy meat, I feel a little hesitant and feel sorry for the money, but I am not willing to eat fat meat.
But the master is an expert in the world, a god-like figure, and he is so kind to me that he deserves this piece of pork.
"Master, I can crush rocks!"
The first time the master and apprentice met, Er Gouzi naturally wanted to share the joy of success with his master.
He is able to achieve what he is today because of his master's guidance.
"How is that possible?"
Li Banxian instinctively felt that it was impossible, how could human fingers crush the stone.
It's not like he hasn't practiced these shabby skills before. Apart from increasing his appetite, he will waste a few more bowls of rice and it will do nothing.
As for the grinding of stone into powder every time I perform, I still have some idea in my mind.
But soon he also realized that he was speechless and continued.
"How could it be so fast?"
As Li Banxian spoke, he picked up a stone from the ground and placed it on the table for Ergouzi to pinch it.
"Crush this stone and show it to me."
Ergouzi picked up the stone on the table and secretly circulated his Qi.
"Bang"
Rubbles scattered everywhere, and a piece of bluestone the size of an egg was crushed into pieces by him, breaking into several pieces.
Li Banxian trembled and pulled at his sparse beard, still unable to conceal the excitement in his heart.
When he picked up the stone, he made sure that it was a real stone and not a prop.
Did you just make a mistake and accidentally pick up a prop stone?
Not giving up, he picked up a small piece of stone crushed by Ergouzi and retracted his hand into his sleeve to squeeze it hard.
pinch!
Squeeze hard!
Grind your teeth!
His face turned red, and the little stone didn't move at all.
Li Banxian once again fell into deep self-doubt and entanglement.
However, after so many years of professionalism, he remained calm and calm.
"Not bad! Not bad!"
"Being able to crush a stone is considered a small achievement."
"However, it is all based on violence, but it still lacks some fire."
Li Banxian felt that it was getting harder and harder to fool him, and he felt very stressed.
"Master's lesson is right. In front of Master, this little skill of this disciple is just like... like those fireflies... competing with the sun and the moon."
Although Ergouzi's cultivation is faster, the enlightenment reading is a book with no beginning or end.
At this moment, I wanted to imitate an educated person and say a few decent words to be modest, but my words came out stumbling.
“It’s pretty good, but it still needs work.”
After all, Li Banxian was an old man, and he quickly struggled out of his mental exhaustion. At this moment, he was calm and calm, showing the demeanor of a master.
"How are you doing with your basic sword skills?"
"I can already practice basic sword styles with a 60-pound epee."
